transcript.text: Thanks, Mara. Let me clarify the certification timing. So if voting closes at a given time, certification is available three minutes after that. It is not tied to the public reveal or the finalist notification per se — those are downstream events that need to happen after certification is complete. So the sequence has to be: voting closes, then 3-minute tally lock, then certification, then whoever needs the certified results can act on them. Tessa's requirement is that finalists are notified at 9:42 PM, which means certification must be complete by 9:42 at the latest — so voting would need to close by 9:39 at the latest.
